# tapir

> E2E driver for Flutter apps targeting LLM agents and CI. 42 CLI commands and 40 MCP tools drive a running Flutter app over 38 `ext.tapir.*` VM Service extensions, 33 of which are reached directly by an MCP tool, plus 7 `dowel:tapir:*` substrate-routed tools. Every gesture passes a 6-step actionability gate (defunct, enabled, zero-rect, off-viewport, stable, receives-events) with substring-parseable failure reasons. Snapshots emit YAML trees with stable `[ref=eN]` tokens; `tapir:find` mints re-resolvable `q<N>` predicate handles (Playwright Locator pattern). The consumer gates with `!kReleaseMode` (debug and profile); release builds tree-shake the entire subsystem.

**MCP tools (40)**, see `doc/mcp/tool-reference.md` for full input schemas. The 33 `ext.tapir.*` and 7 `dowel:tapir:*` (substrate-routed) tools are listed below.

*Snapshot / Screenshot*
- `tapir_snap` (`ext.tapir.snap`): Capture Semantics tree YAML with stable `[ref=eN]` tokens. Narrow instead of reading everything: `within: "e12"` walks one subtree, `interactiveOnly: true` drops the prose, `grep: "<regex>"` keeps only matches plus the ancestors carrying their refs. A full tree costs context, and on a shell whose sidebar repeats page labels the unscoped read is also the misleading one. Nodes inside a currently-overflowing ancestor carry an `overflow: true` sub-line. Nested `textbox` nodes collapse by render-object containment to a single ref tagged `typeable: true` (the node `tapir_type` resolves); sibling fields sharing a label stay distinct. A node absorbed by `MergeSemantics` (`isMergedIntoParent`) prints no line and mints no ref, so a merged control is one ref on its boundary node. When non-fatal render/build FlutterErrors are in the capture buffer, the response includes a `renderErrors: {count, recent: [{type, message}], hint}` block so a silently-broken screen is visible without a separate `tapir_exceptions` call. A `warnings: {framesEnabled, lifecycleState, hint}` block appears on EVERY tool's payload while the app is not producing frames, which is when a rendering screen reads as empty.
- `tapir_screenshot` (`ext.tapir.screenshot`, in-isolate): Capture base64-encoded JPEG/PNG frame. Optional `ref` captures ONLY that widget (an `e<N>`/`q<N>` token), optional `rect: "x,y,w,h"` narrows further within it; reach for `ref` whenever the question is about one component, since a full-screen capture of a tall page costs far more tokens and buries it. Can hang on web under CanvasKit+DWDS; for reliable web screenshots use the CLI `tapir:screenshot --output=<path>`, which falls back to CDP `Page.captureScreenshot` when dowel was started with `--cdp-port` (CLI-only, not this MCP tool).

*Gestures (pointer actions)*
- `tapir_tap` (`ext.tapir.tap`): Tap a widget (Down + 50ms hold + Up at the LIVE ref center, re-resolved post-gate). Every response carries an `effect: {kind: "treeChanged", changed: bool}` block; `changed: false` means the target's own route and semantics subtree are unchanged, so nothing the agent can see happened. `snapshot: "diff"` returns only the snapshot lines the tap changed since the last snapshot. A tap on a merged boundary goes to its one labelled control (`retargeted {from, to, ownerRect}`; `retarget:false` taps the centre); when it cannot, the response carries `tapPointOutsideOwner {ownerRect, point}`. Opt-in `until:"<text>"` polls (up to `untilTimeoutMs`, default 3000) for that text post-tap and adds an `untilMatched` boolean.
- `tapir_hover` (`ext.tapir.hover`): Hover mouse cursor over a widget (PointerHoverEvent).
- `tapir_drag` (`ext.tapir.drag`): Drag from one widget to another (Down + 5x Move + Up).
- `tapir_dblclick` (`ext.tapir.dblclick`): Double-click a widget (two tap sequences ~100ms apart).
- `tapir_right_click` (`ext.tapir.right_click`): Fire secondary (right) mouse button click.
- `tapir_triple_click` (`ext.tapir.triple_click`): Fire three primary clicks (~100ms apart each).

*Text Input*
- `tapir_type` (`ext.tapir.type`): Type text into a TextField (calls userUpdateTextEditingValue).
- `tapir_clear` (`ext.tapir.clear`): Clear TextEditingController backing a text field.
- `tapir_fill` (`ext.tapir.fill`): Focus + clear + type + settle a text field in one call; composes the gated focus/clear/type handlers and retries once on a stale handle. Replaces the manual fill dance. A ref that is a button, checkbox, switch, slider or link is refused; `effect.target {matchKind, label, rect}` says which field was written, and `effect.verified` is read after the settle.

*Scrolling*
- `tapir_scroll` (`ext.tapir.scroll`): Scroll a Scrollable widget by `direction` + `pixels`, by `dx` / `dy`, or `intoView`.

*Waits / Polling*
- `tapir_wait_for` (`ext.tapir.wait_for`): Wait until text/textGone/expression condition met or timeout.
- `tapir_wait_for_network_idle` (`ext.tapir.wait_for_network_idle`): Wait until in-flight HTTP count reaches 0 + idle window.

*Navigation*
- `tapir_navigate` (`ext.tapir.navigate`): Push a named route onto the active router.
- `tapir_navigate_back` (`ext.tapir.navigate_back`): Pop the top route off navigator stack.
- `tapir_get_routes` (`ext.tapir.get_routes`): Report where the app is: the mounted Router's `uri` (null before one mounts), the top page name `location`, and a `title` hint; it does not list declared routes.
- `tapir_dismiss_modals` (`ext.tapir.dismiss_modals`): Pop every PopupRoute (dialog, bottom sheet, popup menu) across all NavigatorState instances; returns additive `popped` count.
- `tapir_reset_overlays` (`ext.tapir.reset_overlays`): Return to a clean screen via 3 idempotent layers: dismiss all PopupRoutes, press Escape, then tap a Cancel/Dismiss/Close/OK/Done affordance. Returns `{popped, escaped, dismissTapped}`.

*Find (Query Handles)*
- `tapir_find` (`ext.tapir.find`): Find widget by text/semanticsLabel/key, return re-resolvable `q<N>` handle. Optional `within: "e12"` evaluates the predicates inside one subtree and becomes part of the handle, so the scope survives every re-resolve (Playwright scoped-locator semantics, including the part where the handle stops matching once its scope is gone).

*Diagnostics*
- `tapir_console` (`ext.tapir.console`): Read recent log entries. Returns merged union of in-package `debugPrint` capture buffer (captures `debugPrint()`, `print()`, and any Flutter framework path through the `debugPrint` callback; does NOT capture direct `developer.log()` calls) and crumbs reader when wired; deduped, newest-first. Works without crumbs.
- `tapir_exceptions` (`ext.tapir.exceptions`): Read recent exception entries. Returns merged union of in-package non-fatal `FlutterError` capture buffer (incl. overflow tagged `type: "overflow"`) and crumbs reader; deduped, newest-first. Optional `since` ISO8601 param filters to entries strictly after that timestamp, and `clear: true` empties the in-package buffer AFTER the read. The buffer is cumulative, so one boot-time fault otherwise rides along on every later read and a per-route sweep reports it against every route.
- `tapir_observe` (`ext.tapir.observe`): Return structured candidate list of every interactive widget on screen.

*Performance*
- `tapir_perf_begin` (`ext.tapir.perf_begin`): Open a measurement session around an interaction you are about to drive. Switches `FlutterTimeline` collection plus `debugProfileBuildsEnabled` on (and, with `phases: true`, layout and paint), zeroes wind's counters and crumbs's frame buffer, and records the liveness baseline. Returns `{sessionToken, phases, livenessBaseline, restartedPreviousSession}`; a begin on an open session restarts it rather than failing.
- `tapir_perf_end` (`ext.tapir.perf_end`): Close the session and read the attribution: `frameSummary` under `flutter_driver`'s own metric names plus a gap-derived `dropped_frame_count`, a session-wide `blockAttribution` ranking `{name, micros, count, frames}`, wind's cache hit/miss/bypass counters and magic's controller notifies. Restores every profiling flag to its PRIOR value. Check `refused` first: a session the engine did not render through returns `refused: true` with a reason and NO metrics, because a table of zeros reads as "fast"; the liveness counter is the authority there, not `SchedulerBinding.framesEnabled`, which was measured reporting `true` on a hidden page. Per-type durations are indicative, not representative.
- `tapir_perf_insight` (`ext.tapir.perf_insight`): Drill into one ranked insight from the last `tapir_perf_end` report by id (e.g. `I1`): title, summary, the rows behind it, estimated savings and the next step.
- `tapir_perf_run` (`dowel:tapir:perf_run`, substrate-routed): Run a perf scenario N times from a clean start (hot restart or relaunch between repeats) and write medians, spread, insights and every repeat to `<out>/<scenario>-<label>.json`.
- `tapir_perf_compare` (`dowel:tapir:perf_compare`, substrate-routed): Compare two `tapir_perf_run` files on counts per painted frame (and timing-mode ms) and print a verdict table. Raw counts are never compared directly since a run that drew fewer frames reads as a false improvement.
- `tapir_perf_trace` (`dowel:tapir:perf_trace`, substrate-routed): Write the last closed perf session's interactions, frames and host rows as Chrome Trace Event JSON (opens in ui.perfetto.dev or chrome://tracing) and return only its path.

*Keyboard / Input*
- `tapir_press_key` (`ext.tapir.press_key`): Press a hardware key (a named key, or one letter or digit) so the focused widget hears it; `modifiers` (control, shift, alt, meta) are held down before the key and released after it.
- `tapir_focus` (`ext.tapir.focus`): Request keyboard focus on widget identified by ref.
- `tapir_blur` (`ext.tapir.blur`): Clear keyboard focus from current focus holder.

*Form Controls*
- `tapir_select_option` (`ext.tapir.select_option`): Select option in DropdownButton by ref + value.
- `tapir_set_checkbox` (`ext.tapir.set_checkbox`): Set checked state of Checkbox or Switch widget.

*Evaluate (MCP-only; no CLI mirror)*
- `tapir_evaluate` (`ext.tapir.evaluate`): Evaluate Dart expression in running app isolate via Tinker bridge.

*App Control*
- `tapir_close_app` (`ext.tapir.close_app`): Request graceful shutdown via `SystemNavigator.pop()`.

*Hot Reload (substrate-routed)*
- `tapir_hot_reload_and_snap` (`dowel:tapir:hot_reload_and_snap`): Hot reload app, capture snapshot + screenshot + recent exceptions in one round-trip.

*Batch (substrate-routed)*
- `tapir_run` (`dowel:tapir:run`): Run several tapir verbs in one call (`steps: ["tap --ref=e5", "snap --grep Total"]`, optional `continue`). One summary line per step, then the last step's output; stops at the first failing step. Saves a round trip per step; use `--text`, `--key` or q-refs between steps, since e-refs belong to one snapshot.

*Viewport / Device Emulation (substrate-routed, CDP)*
- `tapir_resize_viewport` (`dowel:tapir:resize`): Resize Flutter web viewport via Chrome DevTools Protocol; the override lasts only as long as the call's CDP session (the CLI's `tapir:resize --hold` keeps it).
- `tapir_device_profile` (`dowel:tapir:device`): Emulate named device preset via CDP; the emulation lasts only as long as the call's CDP session, only the window size stays.

## AI & Tooling
- [anilcancakir/ai](https://github.com/anilcancakir/ai): canonical distribution channel. One-command install via `npx skills add anilcancakir/ai --skill tapir` covers Claude Code, Cursor, OpenCode, Gemini CLI, VS Code Copilot, Codex CLI, Cline, Roo Code.
- [Tapir skill source](https://github.com/anilcancakir/tapir/tree/master/skills/tapir): canonical `SKILL.md` + references (`mcp-tools.md`, `cli-commands.md`, `actionability-and-refs.md`, `workflows.md`, `community.md`); `anilcancakir/ai` mirrors this directory.
- [Hosted docs MCP server](https://mcp.anilcancakir.com): Streamable HTTP, single `search-docs` tool over the tapir docs corpus, no auth required.
